name: Videco
summary: Hosts your videos and turns webinars, demos and recordings into AI clips, posts and lead-capture pages.
description: Videco is a video hosting and repurposing workspace. Content Studio finds standout moments in a demo, webinar or interview and produces vertical clips, blog drafts and social hooks, then you brand and export them. Hosting adds watch pages with VideoObject schema, personalized share links, booking embeds (Calendly or Cal.com) and a leads workspace with CSV export. New accounts get a 7-day free trial.
